checks.message: Provisional boundary is explicitly disclosed and limited to concept generation, display, and intake review.
Three required key areas remain provisional and replaceable.
Geometry metrics use EPSG:4548 formulas and structured counts have declared source files.
Fact pack path, usable_for_formal status, access dates, snapshot status, and external-source audit limits are recorded.
Three positionings, master name, naming system, logo direction, regional synergy, and non-commitment boundary are independently structured.
Five personas have goals, pain points, touchpoints, data boundaries, and human fallback.
All three industry tests have baselines, responsible roles, human review, exit conditions, and evidence outputs.
Landmark catalog, honor display system, and component library can be referenced from scenario nodes.
Cultural storyline, signage, audiences, media, language strategy, and conversion path are structured.
Annual event system, IP, developer community, scenario intake, landmark cycle, and international conversion path are structured.
Core figures are regenerated with an installed Chinese font; visible metrics carry Chinese units.
Official self-check was run locally on 2026-08-08 after the final package refresh: deterministic validation, spatial review, visual packaging, and professional evidence review all passed.
